description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maahaloluwa, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extent, ownership details, and title classifications) under the Registration of Title Act.
